## Ask your inbox. It answers with sources.

No more folder hunting or keyword guessing. Ask in plain English and TurboMail reads across your mail, answers, and links every claim back to the exact message it came from.

Try it on your own inbox

## An email client first. The AI is wired into all of it.

### Turbo Email Search

Plain-English questions over your whole inbox, with ranked, source-linked answers.

### Local model built in

A fast 1 GB on-device model handles search, summaries, and drafts. Swap in larger models anytime.

### Turbo Agents

Auto-drafted replies for the mail you answer the same way every time. Nothing sends without your approval.

### Inbox Intelligence

A calm overview of what's unread, urgent, or ignorable, plus a spoken morning briefing.

### Subscriptions & Unsubscriber

Catch recurring charges before they bill, and leave any mailing list in one click.

### Turbo Link & Calendar

Google and Outlook calendars, plus a booking link that sets up the Meet or Teams call for you.

## Local first. Explicit when cloud is used.

Most AI email tools process your mail on their servers. TurboMail's default is the opposite. When you do choose cloud, it's your provider, your key, and only the request you asked for.

## Who's behind this. A fair question for an email app.

TurboMail is built by Turbo AI Labs LLC, a small engineering team making the email client we wanted ourselves: fast, private, and honest about how it works. Questions or feedback reach a person, not a queue.

support@turbomail.ai
